declare               v_id number;v_sla number:=300;             begin               select nvl(max(SHORT_RECOVERY_SLA_SECONDS),300) into v_sla from RRL_CASE_PICK_SETTING                where WARE_ID=(select WARE_ID from RRL_CASE_PICK_TASK where CASE_PICK_TASK_ID=:case_pick_task_id) and ACTIVE=1;               select RRL_CASE_PICK_SHORT_SQ.nextval into v_id from dual;               insert into RRL_CASE_PICK_SHORT (                 CASE_PICK_SHORT_ID, PICK_WAVE_ID, CASE_PICK_TASK_ID, CASE_PICK_LINE_ID,                 PICK_WAVE_TASK_ID, CUSTOMER_ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, ARTICUL, CELL_CODE,                 PLANNED_QTY, PICKED_QTY, SHORT_QTY, REASON_TEXT, STATUS,                 OFFLINE_EVENT_ID, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, RECOVERY_DEADLINE_AT               ) values (                 v_id, :pick_wave_id, :case_pick_task_id, :case_pick_line_id,                 :pick_wave_task_id, :customer_order_

update RRL_PICK_WAVE_REPLENISH_TASK set                     REPLENISHMENT_METHOD='IMMEDIATE',REPLENISHMENT_QTY_MODE='FILL_TO_VOLUME',                     QTY=(select l.PLANNED_QTY-l.PICKED_QTY from RRL_CASE_PICK_SHORT sh join RRL_CASE_PICK_LINE l on l.CASE_PICK_LINE_ID=sh.CASE_PICK_LINE_ID where sh.REPLENISH_TASK_ID=RRL_PICK_WAVE_REPLENISH_TASK.PICK_WAVE_REPLENISH_TASK_ID),                     STATUS=case when STATUS in('FAILED','WAIT_FREE_CELL','WAIT_MINIMAX','QUEUED') and SOURCE_RESERVATION_ID is null then 'RELEASED' else STATUS end                     where PICK_WAVE_REPLENISH_TASK_ID=:repl_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RRL_CASE_PICK_SHORT SH WHERE SH.CELL_CODE=:B2 AND SH.ARTICUL=:B1 AND (SH.STATUS IN('CREATED','PENDING_APPROVAL') OR SH.RECOVERY_STATE='WAIT_INVENTORY' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM RRL_INVENTORY_TASK IT WHERE IT.INVENTORY_TASK_ID=SH.INVENTORY_TASK_ID AND IT.STATUS NOT IN('DONE','CANCELLED')))

select wt.TASK_ID,wt.STATUS,wt.ASSIGNED_TO         from RRL_CASE_PICK_SHORT sh join RRL_WAREHOUSE_TASK wt          on wt.TASK_SOURCE='WAVE' and wt.TASK_TYPE='REPLENISHMENT'           and wt.SOURCE_TASK_ID=sh.REPLENISH_TASK_ID         where sh.CASE_PICK_SHORT_ID=:short_id and sh.RECOVERY_STATE='WAIT_REPLENISHMENT'          and wt.PRIORITY=0 and wt.STATUS in('PLANNED','ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS')         order by wt.TASK_ID fetch first 1 row only
